verdict.rationale: Otter documents a scheduled notetaker that auto-joins Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and Google Meet, plus bot-free desktop recording and Google Meet capture without a bot, so the core capture capability exists, and one hands-on user records all their work meetings with it. However, control over where recording happens is not documented, and community reports describe the bot joining meetings on a user's behalf and rejoining despite attempts to stop it, which undercuts the 'recording where I want it' part of the story. Missing for 10: documented per-meeting or per-platform recording controls (opt-in/opt-out rules), independent evidence of reliable capture across all three platforms, and evidence that unwanted auto-joins can be prevented.

support.subject: As a product manager, the notetaker reliably captures Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams meetings, with recording where I want it

citations.quote: Schedule your AI Meeting Notetaker to automatically join all your Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and Google Meet meetings.
